item.title: CVE-2026-6232 · 5.2 MEDIUM — Out-of-bounds write in LR11xx Transceiver
item.description: An out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the SPI host command interface of Semtech's LR11xx transceiver firmware where a crafted SPI host command with an oversized length field can cause the firmware to write up to 254 arbitrary bytes past the bounds…
